description: Templar role builds for the Ascent Plan.

records.label: Shield tank
records.summary: The main tank. Hold threat with Taunt, use Judgment in shield windows and keep Warding Strike for damage tolerance.

coreSkills.name: Vicious Strike
coreSkills.why: Your MP filler. Its Lv 12 perk lowers the Warding Strike cooldown.

coreSkills.name: Judgment
coreSkills.target: Mastery 11, then +4 from Daevanion nodes. The guide's skill level 20 needs more (its skill level 16 perks matter most): Mastery stops at 11 and the build names no other source
coreSkills.why: Main damage hit. Top players put Daevanion points into it on Nezekan.

targetProvenance.note: Mastery stops at skill Lv 11 (mechanics.json, mastery-cap). The guide target "Lv 20 (Lv 16 perks matter most)" is reworded against the cap: the build names this skill's Daevanion nodes, one +1 on each of the first four boards (progression.json, daevanion-boards). Gear and Arcana are not named as a source for this skill.

coreSkills.name: Warding Strike
coreSkills.why: Self heal and damage tolerance buff. At skill Lv 16 it helps the whole party.

picks.pick: Always lands as a critical hit

stigmas.note: Taunt is in every PvE tank set. For pure survival, run Shield of Protection, Taunt, Nezekan's Shield and Second Skin.

rotation.note: These are priorities, not a fixed order. Keep defensive skills on your own keys.
